title: Wicked´s Spawnelytra
description: A Spawnelytra for Forge 1.20.1 like Craftattack
body:
![Wicked´s Spawnelytra](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ce177fc6f41da6518dd565f4ef13d6a584f3369.png)

_Fly like the pros! Inspired by the iconic Craft Attack mechanics, this mod gives you the ultimate mobility right from the start. No complex setups or visible gear – just pure flight._



**How it works:
**


Double Jump to Fly: Simply double-tap your jump key to activate your invisible Elytra and soar off the platform.
![imfly](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64709965f50c38218e7cf2a6cfe119300dcf9137_0.webp)


Press 'F' for Boost: Need more speed? Just hit the 'F' key to get an instant momentum boost while in the air.
![pushfforboost](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f185654081d188d584358dbe43456182706e2e27.png)


It’s the perfect addition for any server that wants fast-paced movement and easy exploration without cluttering the inventory. Just spawn, double-jump, and fly!
